title: Exact criteria for ground-state overlap dominance and dynamical quantum phase transitions
summary: It was recently conjectured and verified for the transverse-field Ising model [Phys. Rev. B 113, 165102 (2026)] that, after a sudden quench within the same equilibrium phase, the initial ground state has its largest overlap with the final ground state. We show that this phase-based criterion is generally false, even in translationally invariant free-fermion systems.
